lights.minPerRoom.note: At least one fixed ceiling light point in each room, worked by a switch (EL-01).

outlets.living.perimeterPer.source: NBR 5410:2004, 9.5.2.2.1 (salas e dormitórios; from memory — to check)
outlets.living.perimeterPer.note: Living rooms and bedrooms: one general outlet per 5 m of perimeter or part of it (EL-01).

outlets.kitchen.perimeterPer.source: NBR 5410:2004, 9.5.2.2.1 (cozinhas, copas, áreas de serviço, lavanderias; from memory — to check)
outlets.kitchen.perimeterPer.note: Kitchens and laundry areas: one outlet per 3.5 m of perimeter or part of it (EL-01).

outlets.bathroom.min.source: NBR 5410:2004, 9.5.2.2.1 (banheiros: junto ao lavatório; from memory — to check)
outlets.bathroom.min.note: Bathrooms: at least one outlet near the washbasin (EL-01).

outlets.other.smallArea.source: NBR 5410:2004, 9.5.2.2.1 (demais cômodos; from memory — to check)
outlets.other.smallArea.note: Other rooms: up to 6 m² at least one outlet; larger, one per 5 m of perimeter (EL-01).
